data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'nilufar' which means 'lotus'. In Islamic tradition, the lotus flower symbolizes purity and enlightenment. The name Neelma carries the meaning “Lovely, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neelma usually hope their child will grow to embody lovely, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
